listMembers.usage:
val roles = listOf(MemberRole.ADMIN)
val response = client.members.listMembers(sort = SortOrder.ASC, role = MemberRole.ADMIN, roles = roles, region = Region.EU)

updateMember.usage:
val request = MemberUpdateRequest(role = MemberRole.ADMIN, kind = MemberKind.REGULAR)
val response = client.members.updateMember(id = 123, request = request)
updateMember.output: Member(id: Int, role: MemberRole, status: MemberStatus, previousStatuses: List<MemberStatus>?)
